retail_vs_institutional_reaction.retail_sentiment_summary: Retail traders on r/wallstreetbets, Threads, and X erupted with bullish momentum following the $64,601M Q3 revenue beat (vs $62,500M consensus), the massive $73B-$76B Q4 revenue guide, and the announcement of the 1-for-1 Class C stock dividend (effectively a 2-for-1 stock split taking effect January 19, 2027). Retail traders immediately looked past the one-time $9.89B ($3.57/sh) State Attorneys General settlement charge to focus on the $7.40 adjusted EPS and Muse Wonder frontier model launch.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.institutional_sentiment_summary: Institutional desks praised the operational print—highlighting +14% YoY ad pricing, +10% YoY ad impressions, 3.64B DAP, a -15% YoY headcount reduction to 66,775, and the commitment to narrow Reality Labs losses to ~$15B in 2027. However, forensic cash-flow PMs flagged that Q3 CapEx hit $33,942M ($34,906M incl. finance leases) against $32,786M OCF, pushing reported FCF negative (-$1,156M standard / -$2,120M incl. leases) and True FCF (ex-$7,363M SBC) to -$9,483M.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.after_hours_movement_driver: META rose +2.12% after hours to $712.31 (up +$14.79 from the $697.52 regular close) as the $64.60B Q3 revenue beat, $73B-$76B Q4 guidance raise, RL loss reduction roadmap, and 2-for-1 Class C stock dividend outweighed the $135B-$145B FY26 CapEx intensity.
